description: Ministry of Defence - Notify the order declare that since a Treaty was signed  at  Ankara on the 02nd  day of December 2018 between the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Republic of Turkey
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the declaration of an extradition treaty between Sri Lanka and Turkey under the Extradition Law. It involves legal framework matters (treaty ratification and application of existing law), making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette rather than a government personnel/structure matter. The mention of the President's name is incidental to the legal declaration process and does not involve detailed portfolio responsibilities.
